serviceDescription: Schellman is the leading FedRAMP Independent Assessor on the Marketplace, with more assessments completed than any other assessor. Our Federal Practice brings deep expertise across FedRAMP Rev5 and 20x frameworks, helping cloud service providers navigate the process efficiently. Beyond FedRAMP, our team supports agencies and CSPs across the full compliance lifecycle across 95+ frameworks, including DoD IL4/5/6 assessments, CJIS, ITAR, CMMC, SOC 2, and ISO 27001, giving clients a single trusted partner as they scale across federal and commercial markets. We combine assessor experience with practical, business-minded guidance, so clients move through the process with fewer surprises and faster time to ATO.
